prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: skull-and-crossbones elite battle marker in a hand-drawn 2D forest mushroom game. Final texture is only 128 x 128 and the icon displays at 56 x 56 pixels.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing skull-and-crossbones icon to improve. Image 2 is the game's newly refined padlock icon, a supporting style reference for matte shading and bold line weight.
Primary request: improve the first icon into a clean readable skull-and-crossbones with the same identity and front-facing upright layout. One large rounded ivory cranium, softly pinched cheekbones, a short jaw with just THREE broad clearly separated tooth shapes instead of many tiny ragged points. Two large dark empty slightly angled eye sockets and one small simple dark inverted triangular nose cavity, no pupils. Preserve a slightly wonky hand-drawn charm. Two ivory bones cross diagonally BEHIND the skull, four rounded double-lobed bone tips visible at upper-left, upper-right, lower-left and lower-right, balanced and integrated into one compact silhouette.
Style: very bold near-black ink outlines, approximately 6–8 pixels thick relative to a 128-pixel final icon, consistent around skull and bones. Same matte warm ivory and muted olive-gray shadow palette as the padlock, only one simple subdued shadow facet along the lower-right of the skull and bone edges. Broad graphic shapes, simple silhouette readable at 56 pixels. Bone interiors and skull interior opaque. Eyes and nose are opaque near-black cavities, not transparent holes.
Composition: front facing, centered, compact roughly square emblem, entire skull and all four bone tips visible with a little clear margin. No extra objects.
Constraints: no tiny cracks, scratches, stippling, fine tooth lines, shiny reflections, white glints, outlines within outlines, extra skulls, text, borders or background shadow. No ghost-like ragged skirt. No realistic gore. Transparent RGBA background with actual alpha and transparent spaces between the bones; absolutely no painted checkerboard.

Output one complete centered icon with true transparent alpha background and no checkerboard. This is only an outline-weight correction.
